comment: Every Mach-O file in a cmux-next app bundle maps to the notices it needs. check_bundle_notices.py fails on a Mach-O that no entry matches and on a missing notice. Requirements: first-party (Contents/Resources/LICENSE), section:<id> (a `<!-- notices-section: <id> -->` marker in Contents/Resources/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md), file:<bundle path> (a non-empty file), ghostty-license-tree:<bundle path> (a Ghostty dependency license tree that verify-ghostty-license-bundle.py accepts), rust-std (each rustc commit named inside the Mach-O is reviewed in cmux-tui/build-support/notices/toolchains/toolchains.json and its COPYRIGHT-library.html is bundled unchanged under Contents/Resources/toolchain-licenses), zig-std (the reviewed Zig LICENSE is bundled unchanged there). Paths are fnmatch patterns relative to the .app; `*` also matches `/`. Add an entry in the same change that adds a binary.

entries.what: the app: Swift packages, GhosttyNextKit (static, Zig; its Termio inlines std.math.cbrt, ported from musl), iroh-ffi (Release merges Iroh.framework's Rust code here: rustc 1.91.0 std), Sparkle client
iroh-ffi (Rust), manaflow-ai/iroh-ffi at the Package.resolved revision; in Release a stub, its code is merged into Contents/MacOS/cmux (a Mach-O that names rustc std paths without rust-std fails)
CEF and Chromium, including libcef_sandbox, SwiftShader and the Vulkan loader
the cmux CLI and daemon (cmux-tui crates; acpmux and libghostty-vt are linked in; check_ghostty_vt_notices.py checks libghostty-vt's Zig packages)
the same cmux-tui binary for remote hosts

browser host (cmux-tui crate cmux-browser-host): rquickjs with the QuickJS-NG C engine (Unicode data tables), sha1; embedded runtime JS with acorn and Playwright injected code (js/vendor, browser-host-js.json)
Ghostty CLI helper (Zig); the Zig package notices follow in S5
first-party server helper (Swift, no third-party code)

resources.what: Ghostty themes from iTerm2-Color-Schemes (Resources/ghostty/themes, or Ghostty's zig-out share)

Ghostty's shell integration scripts from ghostty-next (bundle-ghostty-resources.sh): bash-preexec 0.7.0 (MIT), Kitty-derived bash/zsh files (GPL-3.0-or-later); rows in cmux-tui/build-support/notices/ghostty/shell-integration.json
Ghostty dependency license tree with the MPL-2.0 source offer (collect-ghostty-licenses.py; nightly-next)
ghostty-next dependency license tree with its MPL-2.0 source offers: the libghostty-vt in bin/cmux (collect-ghostty-licenses.py on the submodule ghostty-vt-sys's build.rs names; nightly-next)
